caseNameFull: Evelyn P. Ferry v. Henry L. Corbett
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Charles Haldane for appellant. Mr. Joseph Simon for appellees. .

opinions.text:
Decree affirmed with costs, and cause remanded to

the District Court of the United States for the District of Oregon, per stipulation of counsel that this case abide decision in case No. 177, ante, 314.
